tree: kiln-84 working tree on 4ccae671 with the review amendments (stale_fence retained, run-only refusal settlement, bound program and state root, strict refusal and closure records, credential before plan reservation)
scope: Kiln's kiln-lattice-dispatch --worker-request transport against the real Lattice db64cd65 binary, every worker the pinned OMP in bubblewrap reaching only a local HTTP 400 endpoint (endpoint.py). No model, provider, forge or remote was contacted. The live scenario was not run.

harness-Cargo.toml.change: only the Kiln path dependencies point at the kiln-84 tree

qualify.sh.change: attempt() prepares twice to bind dispatch_plan; refusals adds kiln-unplanned and stale-fence-replay; lost_before_start writes the transport binding and creates the bound root exactly as worker::run does before the harness persists the transport intent; new scenarios crossed, substituted_dispatched and moved_root

summarize.py.change: kiln_attempt also reports workflow, failure and cause

lattice.build: cargo build --release --locked -p lattice in the Lattice dev shell with empty RUSTC_WRAPPER, then nix store add-path

kiln_lattice_dispatch.build: cargo build --locked -p kiln-adapter-lattice --bin kiln-lattice-dispatch on the amended kiln-84 tree

pins.pins_note: OMP, bubblewrap, socat and shell bytes equal the pins in Lattice's composed-qualification.json

commands.environment: LATTICE=<lattice pin> KILN=$W/kiln-45f-target/debug/kiln-lattice-dispatch HARNESS=$W/kiln-45f-target/debug/k45-harness OMP BWRAP SOCAT WORKER_SHELL=<pins> OUT=/tmp/k45f (W=/home/brittonr/.cargo-target/producer-work)
commands.qualify: qualify.sh run lost_before_start lost_during_run refusals crossed substituted_dispatched moved_root cancel

run.observed: dispatch_plan is bound and echoed; the single execution is reconciled and the duplicate recovers in the bound root without a second endpoint request.

lattice_stdout.stale-fence-replay: status not_started_closed_by_recovery from recover in the bound root

refusals.observed: stale_fence is no longer settled: the dispatch keeps the attempt with its transport intent ("retain state and reconcile"). The replay recovers with the bound program and root; Lattice finds no intent there and exclusively closes the attempt, and Kiln records that closure as no execution. kiln-crossed-fence (plan fence + 1) is now refused at claim authorization (implementation_fence_stale) because authorization precedes the request cross-check; it remains refused before any durable step. kiln-unplanned is refused before plan reservation.

crossed.observed: A run refusal of a reason the reviewer verified settles; the replay is refused by Kiln before transport.

lost-before-start.observed: With the binding and bound root retained before the transport intent, recovery runs in the bound root and its exact closure record is settled as no execution.

lost-during-run.observed: SIGKILL of the controller; bound recovery reconciles the retained result without re-execution.

kiln_attempt.transport_intent: retained (the second Kiln call ran recover)

substituted-dispatched.observed: dispatched:true from run and every recover refusal are retained for reconciliation.

moved-root.observed: The first run executed under root A. The profile was changed to root B (an existing empty directory). Kiln's next call recovered with the bound root A, reconciled the retained execution, and created nothing in B.

cancel.observed: SIGTERM forwarded as implementation-attempt cancel with the bound root, as before.

changed: refusals: stale_fence stays retained on dispatch; the bound recovery then closes the attempt and Kiln settles it as no execution (before: retained with an unreconciled intent forever)
lost-before-start: the bound recovery's closure is no execution (before: reconciled as an execution); the replay is refused
worker requests carry dispatch_plan; observations echo it
comparison_with_lattice_evidence.unchanged: run, lost-during-run and cancel exits and endpoint request counts

non_claims: No model was called; every worker reached only the local HTTP 400 endpoint, so no candidate was produced
The credential pass-through was exercised by unit tests and a real child process, not by this composed run; every broker here declares credential:null
The bound state root is assumed durable; losing or replacing it in place voids the no-start evidence of a closure recovered from it
The Lattice binary is a local release build of the published commit added to the Nix store, not a Nix-built package
The live scenario, Kiln #49 deployment and Kiln #46 independent acceptance remain separate
